pr_title: Use unified name for background/track files on editor import
pr_body:
- Closes #18585 

To avoid issues with unicode text and what not, background and audio tracks now get automatically renamed to `bg.xyz`/`audio.xyz`. This also matches stable editor behaviour (for the audio track at least).

In addition, the file chooser no longer shows the filename since it's constant now. I wasn't sure how to approach this appropriately but went with the simplest method of overriding `LabelledComponent.Current` and detaching it from the underlying `TextBox` (I've looked into replicating the placeholder text UI but fell into aligning issues instead).

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/173763675-05c44e58-8e05-43aa-98ea-f3080ba1f971.mp4

UI open for feedback, I'm not entirely sure on that front.
pr_comments: I've pushed one commit to clean up the workaround added in [db02cb8](https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18703/commits/db02cb81c5aac24b82f08986d8c43a28ad24d208) - please check if you're OK with it. The workaround is a bit dicey but I think it's still on the side of tolerable.
Have pushed merge conflict resolution (conflict was rather trivial, caused by https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18743).

comments:
`osz`/`zip` doesn't support unicode great. And we don't support it at all at a BSS level.

- Audio tracks should generally be automatically renamed to `audio.mp3`
- Unicode should be stripped from filenames on editor import

> Audio tracks should generally be automatically renamed to `audio.mp3`

Should the same not apply to beatmap backgrounds? (i.e. having them `background.png` instead). And if it were to be applied on both background and track, would that make stripping unicode no longer necessary since they're automatically renamed to english?

Unless you're stating two separate directions to tackle this issue.

Also if we are going with automatically renaming backgrounds and tracks, that would make the filename text display in the setup options no longer point to the original filenames, unsure what to do about that (first thoughts are removing filename text and displaying "Click to replace the background image", maybe)

Stable already does the renaming part, at least for audio filenames, and I think this makes sense to retain in lazer. The sanitisation will likely still be required for storyboard resources going forward regardless.

Updating the UI controls as you propose sounds fine.

review_comments:
These initial value specs change behaviour from `master`.

On `master`, if you open the dropdowns on a map that already has a background/audio file, you will start browsing in your home directory. On this branch, the initial directory is the directory where the osu! executable lies.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/174128390-f4d10f54-e476-4f1a-af28-fa7d9ed3683e.mp4

Seems like a pretty big UX regression.
